#GHerbo is allegedly stepping away from the rap game. 

The Chicago rapper is reportedly taking a step back from music to put more focus on his mental health, personal life, and simply enjoying life outside of the pressures that come with being in the industry.

In the statement circulating online, Herbo described the rap game as “draining,” “stressful,” and “full of weirdos,” before making it clear that he’s tired of the environment surrounding it.

“The rap game is draining, full of weirdos and it’s stressful… I’m done with this rap sh*t.”

For an artist who has spent years navigating the highs and lows of the music industry, the comments have sparked plenty of discussion among fans. Whether this is a permanent retirement or simply Herbo taking a step back remains to be seen.

Is he for real or just trolling?🤔
